escalation.title: Adaptive cooldown escalation
escalation.description: Grow a key's cooldown TTL while it keeps failing, instead of re-enabling it at the same TTL every time.
escalation.maxMultiplierDescription: How many times the base TTL may grow at most (1–16).
escalation.effectiveSummary: escalation up to {{multiplier}}× the base TTL

capacity.title: Retrospective capacity gate
capacity.description: Account real token and request usage over a rolling window, and stop sending requests to a provider once its budget is (nearly) spent.
capacity.tokenLimitDescription: Tokens allowed per window. 0 = no token limit.
capacity.requestLimitDescription: Requests allowed per window. 0 = no request limit.
capacity.windowSecondsDescription: Length of the rolling accounting window (10–3600).
capacity.headroomDescription: Fraction of the limit that may be used before the gate engages — 0.9 blocks once 90% is spent (0.1–1.0).
capacity.scopeDescription: Share one budget across every model of a provider, keep an independent budget per model, or keep an independent budget per credential and model (a key over its own budget is rotated past, the others keep serving).
capacity.actionDescription: Hand the request to the configured fallback chain, or reject it outright.
capacity.actionFallback: Hand off to the fallback chain

action.fallback: hand off to the fallback chain

learning.title: Limit learning (read-only)
learning.description: Watch upstream rate-limit rejections and estimate the provider's effective per-window limit. Recommendations only — the configuration is never changed automatically.
learning.windowSecondsDescription: Length of the rolling window used for the estimate (10–3600).
learning.maxSamplesDescription: How many rate-limit samples to keep per provider (5–500).
learning.minSamplesDescription: How many samples are needed before an estimate is reported (1–100).
learning.suggestionsEmpty: Not enough rate-limit samples yet — no estimate for this provider.
learning.rpmOnlyHint: Only request-rate (RPM) rejections were observed for this pair, so no token estimate is available.
learning.windowMismatch: This estimate uses a {{learned}}s window while the capacity gate uses {{capacity}}s, so the numbers are not directly interchangeable.

capacityUsage.title: Capacity water level
capacityUsage.description: Real usage inside the capacity gate's rolling window, as the plugin sees it right now.
capacityUsage.empty: No traffic in the current window (the gate may not be enabled yet).
capacityUsage.emptyDisabled: The capacity gate is turned off for this provider.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.subtitle: Get the most out of celer-route in 4 short steps.
quickStart.step1Desc: Add upstream provider keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.) so celer-route has something to route to.
quickStart.step2Desc: Define routing rules that decide which provider, model, or key each request lands on. Use fallbacks, weights, or custom expressions.
quickStart.step3Desc: Send a real chat completion through a configured provider to confirm end-to-end connectivity and routing works.
quickStart.step4Desc: Track tokens, cost, latency and errors in Logs and Analytics to tune providers and catch regressions early.
